C1795.title: Yu Sentenced for Stealing Customer Personal Information
C1795.summary: In March 2021, Yu joined a Guangzhou e-commerce company and used a customer-service account and implanted collection software to illegally obtain 21,588 transaction records and 909 personal-information records within two days. The court sentenced Yu to three years and two months in prison and a RMB 5,000 fine for infringing citizens' personal information, while also granting the procuratorate's public-interest claims.
